label: Now Developing
items: House prosecutors dropped the bribery article against Vice President Sara Duterte and closed with a forensic analyst's ₱817.88-million unexplained-wealth estimate; cross-examination begins October 12.
The ICC found Rodrigo Duterte fit to stand trial on November 30 and refused to narrow the charges, while the Sandiganbayan let a jailed Martin Romualdez sign his pre-trial order and appear by video.
September inflation returned to a three-year high of 7.2%, and anti-dynasty campaigners took their push to a people's initiative after the Supreme Court's mandamus ruling.
